summary: A small open-source specimen for Red Hat's Overpass (after Highway Gothic): one 'about' view with a product-style hero, animated per-letter slogans and a split-flap board, plus two hidden 'Try it' / 'Try Mono' views switched by a fixed three-tab bar built from CSS radio inputs (weight radios, italic checkbox, one shared text field, waterfall/glyphs/variants tabs).

instances.look: Fixed full-width top bar of three equal 480px green tabs, 'OVERPASS' (darker #1c7c4c, active) | 'TRY IT' | 'TRY MONO' (#339966), white caps ~11px; they are <label>s for radio inputs that swap the whole page between the about view and two hidden tester views

Centred 'OVERPASS' in Black caps on near-white, a two-line credit ('inspired by Highway Gothic. Sponsored by Red Hat — Created by Delve Fonts'), a slate 'Visit the source on GitHub' button, a green 'Desktop OTF Files' button and two monospaced CDN stylesheet URLs
instances.ux: Buttons go to the GitHub repo and a release zip; the CDN URLs are read-only inputs that select themselves on click for copy-paste
instances.learn: For an open-source family, put the embed URL right in the hero as a click-to-select field: the hero is also the install instructions

reconstruction.layout: First screen ~556px tall under the 48px fixed tab bar; single centred column: name at y≈90, credit 2 lines at y≈270, buttons 320×50px stacked with 18px gap, then two centred URL fields ~13px Mono
reconstruction.typography: Name 144px Overpass Black (900), all caps, tight; credit ~14px Regular grey with blue inline links; buttons ~13px Regular white on fill; URLs ~14px Overpass Mono
reconstruction.content: Real facts: inspiration (Highway Gothic), sponsor (Red Hat), maker (Delve Fonts); links to GitHub release 3.0.2 desktop zip and kxcdn CSS files
reconstruction.html: article.about > h1 + p (credits) + a.button.repo + a.button.download + .cdn > label > input[type=text][readonly][onclick='this.select()']

instances.look: Two slogan bands: 'Smashed Apart / a complete rebuild' (Black over Thin) centred on light grey, then 'Eight Weights / Plus true italics / and monospace' in white over a dark, desaturated photo of a highway underpass, each line set in the style it announces
instances.ux: No interaction; letters animate in one by one (scatter and settle for 'Smashed Apart', weight or fade flicker on the photo lines) when the band appears
instances.learn: Make each claim line its own proof: 'Plus true italics' set in the italic, 'and monospace' in the mono, so the family range is read and seen at once

reconstruction.layout: Band 1: full-width ~300px tall, #ececec, two centred lines; band 2: full-width ~400px, background photo (underpass) darkened to ~20% brightness, three centred lines with ~40px leading gaps
reconstruction.typography: 'Smashed Apart' ~72px Overpass Black (900), sentence case, dark slate #2a3240; 'a complete rebuild' at .75em (~54px) weight 200; photo lines ~48px white: 'Eight Weights' 900, 'Plus true italics' 900 italic, 'and monospace' Overpass Mono 900, some letters lighter mid-animation
reconstruction.behaviour: Lettering.js wraps each letter in span.charN; CSS keyframes ('effect', 'fadeit', 'peekaboo') with per-letter delays: letters drop and scatter then reassemble ('smashed apart'), others fade in; runs on load, not scroll-scrubbed
reconstruction.content: Feature slogans: 'Smashed Apart — a complete rebuild', 'Eight Weights', 'Plus true italics', 'and monospace'
reconstruction.assets: Desaturated photo of a concrete highway underpass with pedestrians
reconstruction.html: .sample-2 / .sample-3 > h3.letter[aria-label] > span.char1…charN[aria-hidden]; weights set inline (font-weight:900 / 200; font-style:italic; font-family:overpass-mono)

instances.look: A split-flap departure board: 'MONOSPACE' in white Mono capitals on nine glossy red flap tiles, then 'FOR THAT ANALOG FEEL' on smaller dark-grey tiles with a hinge line through each letter, on near-black
instances.ux: Static to the visitor; letters flicker in like flaps turning (CSS per-letter animation)
instances.learn: Put each monospaced character on its own flap tile: the fixed advance width becomes the visual grid of a Solari board

reconstruction.layout: Full-width ~380px band on #12141a; centred row of 9 red tiles ~96×100px with 4px gaps; below, word groups of grey tiles ~56×64px, gaps between words
reconstruction.typography: MONOSPACE ~110px Overpass Mono Regular white caps, one per tile; FOR THAT ANALOG FEEL ~44px Overpass Mono, letterspaced by the tiles
reconstruction.behaviour: Per-letter CSS animation (Lettering.js spans) mimicking flaps settling; a horizontal hinge line and dots at tile edges are drawn with CSS
reconstruction.content: Slogan 'MONOSPACE FOR THAT ANALOG FEEL'; the hidden Mono view reuses the board for 'COLLABORATION' and a timetable (Bengaluru 20SEP, Singapore 29SEP, Tokyo 5OCT, Seoul 11OCT, Hong Kong 27OCT, Sydney 3NOV)

instances.look: Hidden views (HTML only, never shown in the capture) opened by the 'TRY IT' / 'TRY MONO' tabs: a row of weight radios labelled '2 00' … '9 00', an 'italic' checkbox and one 'Type Here' text field above tabbed sample panels
instances.ux: Typing in the single field rewrites every sample (.tr) on both views; weight radios and the italic checkbox restyle all samples; sub-tabs switch 'waterfall | glyphs | variants' (proportional) or 'glyphs | syntax | display' (mono)
instances.learn: A whole tester can run on radio inputs and :checked sibling selectors, with only one line of JS to copy the typed text into every sample

reconstruction.layout: Page-level view switch: body > input[radio name=family] ×3 + labels in the fixed bar; tester controls are a row of 8 weight labels + italic checkbox + full-width text input; below, a 3-tab carousel of sections (waterfall: SVG onion-skin of 8 overlaid 'Overpass' weights + 8 sample lines; variants: 8 h2 rows roman + italic, Thin→Heavy; glyphs: glyph chart)
reconstruction.typography: Samples 'Overpass' / 'Overpass Mono' at display size in Overpass 200–900 roman and italic; weight labels show the hundreds digit large and '00' small
reconstruction.behaviour: #type-sample keyup/change → $('.tr').text(value) (all samples including two mono <textarea>s, dark and light); input#variant-200…900 radios and #variant-italic checkbox drive CSS via :checked ~ selectors; carousel radios show one section at a time
reconstruction.content: Default text is the family name; placeholder prompt 'Type Here'; the mono 'display' tab is a split-flap timetable of Red Hat event cities and dates
reconstruction.html: input#variant-200…#variant-900[type=radio][name=variant] + label ('200'), input#variant-italic[type=checkbox], input#type-sample[type=text][placeholder='Type Here ']; article.standard-sample with input#carousel-1..3 (waterfall | glyphs | variants); article.monospace-sample with #mono-carousel-1..3 (glyphs | syntax | display), section.syntax > textarea.tr ×2

instances.look: In the hidden tester views' 'glyphs' tabs: a chart of single-character cells from '!' through Latin-1 and Latin Extended (≈257 cells for Overpass, ≈948 elements in the Mono view, which adds a big 'Overpass Mono' sample line on top)
instances.ux: Reached by a sub-tab; restyled by the global weight radios and italic checkbox
instances.learn: Letting the tester's weight controls also drive the glyph chart turns a static grid into a per-weight coverage check

reconstruction.layout: div.glyph-chart of plain <div>s in encoding order, flowing as a wrapping grid
reconstruction.typography: Cells in Overpass / Overpass Mono at the weight chosen in the toolbar; sizes unknown (not rendered in the capture)
reconstruction.behaviour: Shown when its tab radio is :checked; weight/italic inherit from the global radios
reconstruction.content: ASCII + Latin-1 + extended Latin in encoding order

instances.look: Dark charcoal footer: large 'Sponsored by Red Hat' logo, a small tracked 'WEBFONT HOSTING SPONSORS' label, and three host logos (Google Fonts, KeyCDN, Font Library) framed by laurel wreaths like awards, each above an outlined 'CSS Direct' button; round black back-to-top button bottom right
instances.ux: Logos link to each host's Overpass page; 'CSS Direct' links go straight to that host's stylesheet; ↑ returns to top
instances.learn: Treat webfont hosts as laurel-wreathed sponsors and pair each with a direct CSS link: thanks and install options in one row

reconstruction.typography: Label ~11px Overpass caps, tracked +0.15em, grey #aaa; buttons ~13px Regular grey
